<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>MetaSync AI — AI-Powered MT5 Trading Console & EA Injector</title>
<meta name="description" content="MetaSync AI is an AI-powered MetaTrader 5 (MT5) trading console: AI strategy parsing, AI Vision chart scanner, live price streaming, MQL5 EA generator and a multi-execution auto-trading engine." />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000" />

<!-- Open Graph -->
<meta property="og:title" content="MetaSync AI — AI-Powered MT5 Trading Console" />
<meta property="og:description" content="Inject trades into any MT5 terminal with AI. AI Vision chart scanner, live prices, MQL5 EA generator and auto-trading." />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<meta property="og:url" content="https://metasync-ai.com/" />
<meta property="og:image" content="https://metasync-ai.com/assets/hero.png" />

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

<!-- QR library (client-side). Falls back to a QR image service if unavailable. -->
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js" defer></script>

<style>
/* ============================================================
   MetaSync AI — Brand palette (mirrors the Android app theme)
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --black:#000000;
  --bg:#080808;
  --surface:#121212;
  --surface-2:#1C1C1E;
  --card:#1E1E22;
  --border:#2C2C2E;
  --border-gold:#4A3E18;

  --gold:#FFD700;
  --gold-metallic:#D4AF37;
  --gold-dark:#B8860B;
  --gold-light:#FFE484;
  --gold-container:#332700;

  --yellow:#FFE600;
  --amber:#FFC107;

  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --smoke:#F5F5F7;
  --text:#FFFFFF;
  --text-2:#D1D1D6;
  --muted:#8E8E93;

  --green:#00E676;
  --red:#E53935;

  --radius:18px;
  --radius-sm:12px;
  --maxw:1180px;
  --shadow-gold:0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,.18);
  --grad-gold:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFE600 0%,#FFD700 45%,#D4AF37 100%);
}

/* Content protection: images can't be dragged or long-press saved */
img{ -webkit-user-drag:none; -khtml-user-drag:none; user-drag:none;
     -webkit-touch-callout:none; user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; }

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:var(--black);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4,.font-display{font-family:'Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
.gold{color:var(--gold)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.center{text-align:center}

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#0b0b0b}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2c2c2e;border-radius:8px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--gold-dark)}

/* ================= Buttons ================= */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;justify-content:center;
  font-family:'Outfit',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;
  padding:14px 24px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid transparent;
  cursor:pointer;transition:.22s transform,.22s box-shadow,.22s background,.22s color;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-gold{background:var(--grad-gold);color:#000;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(255,215,0,.28)}
.btn-gold:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(255,215,0,.5);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--white);border-color:var(--border-gold)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,215,0,.06)}
.btn-dark{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--white);border-color:var(--border)}
.btn-dark:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 16px;font-size:13.5px;border-radius:10px}
.btn-block{width:100%}

/* ================= Top bar ================= */
.topbar{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a1400,#332700,#1a1400);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);
  font-size:13px;color:var(--gold-light);text-align:center;padding:8px 14px;
}
.topbar b{color:var(--yellow)}

/* ================= Nav ================= */
header.nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  background:rgba(8,8,8,.78);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(74,62,24,.5);
}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:70px;gap:18px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.logo .mark{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:var(--grad-gold);box-shadow:var(--shadow-gold);flex:0 0 auto;
}
.logo .mark svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.logo small{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-family:'Inter'}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}
.nav-links a{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-2);transition:.2s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:9px;cursor:pointer}
.burger span{display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin:4px 0;border-radius:2px}

/* ================= Hero ================= */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:70px 0 60px}
.hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover no-repeat;
  opacity:.32;filter:saturate(1.05);
}
.hero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 78% 18%,rgba(255,215,0,.16),transparent 60%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.55),rgba(0,0,0,.92));
}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:54px;align-items:center}
.pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--gold-light);background:rgba(255,215,0,.08);
  border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px;margin-bottom:22px;
}
.pill .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--green)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,64px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:20px}
.hero h1 .grad{background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p.lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,19px);color:var(--text-2);max-width:560px;margin-bottom:30px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:34px}
.hero-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:34px}
.hero-stats .stat b{font-family:'Outfit';font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold);display:block;line-height:1}
.hero-stats .stat span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}

/* Phone mockup */
.phone-stage{display:flex;justify-content:center;perspective:1400px}
.phone{
  width:300px;height:612px;border-radius:44px;background:#000;
  border:2px solid #2a2a2a;box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 70px rgba(255,215,0,.16),inset 0 0 0 6px #0a0a0a;
  position:relative;padding:14px 12px;transform:rotateY(-11deg) rotateX(3deg);transition:transform .5s;
}
.phone:hover{transform:rotateY(-4deg) rotateX(1deg)}
.phone .notch{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:96px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;z-index:5}
.screen{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0b0b,#050505);overflow:hidden;position:relative;border:1px solid #1a1a1a}
.scr-status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 16px 4px}
.scr-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #1c1c1c}
.scr-head .t{font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--gold)}
.scr-head .t small{display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-family:'Inter'}
.scr-badge{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;color:#000;background:var(--grad-gold);padding:3px 7px;border-radius:6px}
.scr-body{padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.mini-card{background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.mini-label{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold-light);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.mini-select{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#0f0f10;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.mini-select .caret{color:var(--gold)}
.mini-credits{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end}
.mini-credits .num{font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:800;font-size:26px;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.mini-credits .num small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.mini-credits .tag{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-container);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:5px}
.mini-btn{background:var(--grad-gold);color:#000;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;text-align:center;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;margin-top:9px}
.chart-box{background:#0d0d0e;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.chart-box .price{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.chart-box .price .up{color:var(--green)}
.chart-box .price .dn{color:var(--red)}
.chart-box svg{width:100%;height:74px;display:block}
.mini-row{display:flex;gap:8px}
.mini-row .b{flex:1;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 4px}
.mini-row .b.cam{background:var(--grad-gold);color:#000}
.mini-row .b.up{background:transparent;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold)}
.glowline{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.5}

/* ================= Marquee ================= */
.marquee{border-top:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);background:#0b0b0b;overflow:hidden;padding:16px 0}
.marquee-track{display:flex;gap:52px;white-space:nowrap;animation:scroll 26s linear infinite;width:max-content}
.marquee-track span{font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.marquee-track span::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
@keyframes scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ================= Sections ================= */
section{padding:88px 0;position:relative}
.sec-head{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 54px;text-align:center}
.sec-tag{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,44px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:16px}
.sec-head p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:16.5px}

/* Products grid */
.grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--surface));
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;
  transition:.25s transform,.25s border-color,.25s box-shadow;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--border-gold);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--grad-gold);opacity:0;transition:.25s}
.card:hover::after{opacity:1}
.card .ico{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;
  background:var(--gold-container);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);
}
.card .ico svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.card h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:9px}
.card p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:14.5px}
.card .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:15px}
.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold-light);background:rgba(255,215,0,.07);border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px}

/* Steps */
.steps{counter-reset:s}
.step{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:flex-start;padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.step:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.step .n{
  counter-increment:s;flex:0 0 auto;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:#000;background:var(--grad-gold);
}
.step .n::before{content:counter(s)}
.step h4{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.step p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:14.5px}

/* ================= Download ================= */
#download{background:
  radial-gradient(900px 500px at 15% 0%,rgba(255,215,0,.12),transparent 60%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0b0b,#000);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);
}
.dl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.dl-panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--border-gold);border-radius:24px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.dl-version{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}
.vbadge{font-family:'Outfit';font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#000;background:var(--grad-gold);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:10px}
.vmeta{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.dl-buttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:24px}
.dl-notes{background:#0d0d0e;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-2)}
.dl-notes b{color:var(--gold)}
.dl-steps{list-style:none;margin-top:14px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.dl-steps li{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.dl-steps li::before{content:"✓";color:var(--green);font-weight:800}
.qr-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:34px}
.qr-frame{background:#fff;padding:16px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(255,215,0,.25);position:relative}
.qr-frame img,.qr-frame canvas{display:block;width:210px;height:210px}
.qr-frame .corner{position:absolute;width:26px;height:26px;border:3px solid var(--gold)}
.qr-frame .c1{top:-3px;left:-3px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0;border-radius:6px 0 0 0}
.qr-frame .c2{top:-3px;right:-3px;border-left:0;border-bottom:0;border-radius:0 6px 0 0}
.qr-frame .c3{bottom:-3px;left:-3px;border-right:0;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 0 6px}
.qr-frame .c4{bottom:-3px;right:-3px;border-left:0;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 6px 0}
.qr-cap{text-align:center}
.qr-cap b{font-family:'Outfit';font-size:17px}
.qr-cap p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.dl-url{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);word-break:break-all;max-width:260px;text-align:center;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace}

/* ================= Login ================= */
#login{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#000,#0a0a0a)}
.login-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:46px;align-items:center}
.login-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.field{margin-bottom:16px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.field input{
  width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:#0b0b0b;border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-family:inherit;outline:none;transition:.2s;
}
.field input:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,215,0,.12)}
.form-msg{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;min-height:20px;margin:4px 0 14px;text-align:center}
.form-msg.ok{color:var(--green)}
.form-msg.err{color:var(--red)}
.form-msg.info{color:var(--gold)}
.login-links{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;margin-top:16px}
.login-links a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
.login-links a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.login-feats{display:grid;gap:18px}
.login-feat{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
.login-feat .ic{flex:0 0 auto;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold-container);border:1px solid var(--border-gold)}
.login-feat .ic svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.login-feat h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px}
.login-feat p{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2)}

/* About / stats band */
.band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:10px}
.band .b{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.band .b b{font-family:'Outfit';font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold);display:block}
.band .b span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}

/* Contact */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.contact-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:26px;text-align:center}
.contact-card .ic{width:50px;height:50px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold-container);border:1px solid var(--border-gold)}
.contact-card h4{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.contact-card a,.contact-card p{color:var(--text-2);font-size:14px}
.contact-card a:hover{color:var(--gold)}

/* Footer */
footer{background:#050505;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:60px 0 30px}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:34px;margin-bottom:40px}
.foot-brand p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-top:14px;max-width:320px}
.foot-col h5{font-family:'Outfit';font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--gold)}
.foot-col a{display:block;color:var(--text-2);font-size:14px;padding:5px 0;transition:.2s}
.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.foot-bottom{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:24px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.socials{display:flex;gap:10px}
.socials a{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);transition:.2s}
.socials a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-container)}
.socials svg{width:18px;height:18px}

/* Reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ================= Responsive ================= */
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:44px}
  .phone-stage{order:-1}
  .dl-grid,.login-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .band{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .nav-links{display:none}
  .nav-links.open{display:flex;position:absolute;top:70px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:#0a0a0a;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-gold);padding:8px 0}
  .nav-links.open a{padding:14px 22px;width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
  .burger{display:block}
  .nav-cta .btn-ghost{display:none}
  .grid-3,.grid-2,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .band{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .hero-stats{gap:22px}
  section{padding:64px 0}
  .dl-panel,.qr-panel,.login-card{padding:24px}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
  .band{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-cta .btn{width:100%}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

        <div class="step"><div class="n"></div><div><h4>Allow WebRequest in MT5</h4><p>In MetaTrader 5 go to <b>Tools → Options → Expert Advisors</b> and add the backend URL to the allowed list.</p></div></div>
        <div class="step"><div class="n"></div><div><h4>Attach the EA</h4><p>Generate your Expert Advisor and attach it to any chart — symbols and live prices sync automatically.</p></div></div>
        <div class="step"><div class="n"></div><div><h4>Inject &amp; automate</h4><p>Use the Injector Hub, AI Quant or Scanner tab to inject trades and run automated strategies.</p></div></div>

        <div class="mini-label" style="font-size:11px">WHY TRADERS CHOOSE METASYNC AI</div>

          <div class="b" style="text-align:left"><b>&lt;1s</b><span>Signal to terminal</span></div>

          <a href="#" aria-label="YouTube"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#FFD700"><path d="M23 12s0-3.2-.4-4.7c-.2-.8-.9-1.5-1.7-1.7C19.4 5.2 12 5.2 12 5.2s-7.4 0-8.9.4c-.8.2-1.5.9-1.7 1.7C1 8.8 1 12 1 12s0 3.2.4 4.7c.2.8.9 1.5 1.7 1.7 1.5.4 8.9.4 8.9.4s7.4 0 8.9-.4c.8-.2 1.5-.9 1.7-1.7.4-1.5.4-4.7.4-4.7ZM9.8 15.3V8.7l5.7 3.3-5.7 3.3Z"/></svg></a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="foot-col">
        <h5>Product</h5>
        <a href="#products">Features</a>
        <a href="#services">Services</a>
        <a href="#download">Download</a>
        <a href="#how">How it works</a>
      </div>
      <div class="foot-col">
        <h5>Company</h5>
        <a href="#about">About us</a>
        <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
        <a href="#login">Client login</a>
        <a href="#" id="adminLink">Admin</a>
      </div>
      <div class="foot-col">
        <h5>Legal</h5>
        <a href="#">Terms of Service</a>
        <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a>
        <a href="#">Risk Disclaimer</a>
        <a href="#">Refund Policy</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="foot-bottom">
      <span>© <span id="year"></span> MetaSync AI. All rights reserved.</span>
      <span class="muted">Trading involves risk. Past performance is not indicative of future results.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   SITE CONFIG — edit these values for your deployment
   ============================================================ */
const SITE_CONFIG = {
  /* API base.
     - Leave "" if this page is served by the SAME backend (Render app) -> same-origin.
     - If hosted on a different domain, set to your backend, e.g.
       "https://jrmacapagal-2.onrender.com"  (and enable CORS on the backend). */
  apiBase: "",

  /* Endpoint that returns the latest app release (JSON). See DEPLOY.md for the contract. */
  releaseEndpoint: "/api/app/latest",

  /* Fallback values used if the release endpoint is unreachable. */
  fallback: {
    version: "1.0.0",
    versionCode: 1,
    sizeBytes: 28098805,
    url: "https://metasync-ai.com/downloads/metasync-ai-latest.apk",
    releasedAt: "",
    notes: "Latest MetaSync AI build for Android."
  },

  /* Where the QR code and "copy link" point. Keep this STABLE so printed QR codes
     never change — the backend can redirect it to the newest APK. */
  downloadPageUrl: "https://metasync-ai.com/download",

  /* Where "Client login" / register / admin send the user.
     If this landing page lives at "/", move the portal to "/portal". */
  portalUrl: "/portal",
  registerUrl: "/portal?register=1",
  forgotUrl: "/portal?forgot=1",
  adminUrl: "https://jrmacapagal-2.onrender.com/dashboard",

  /* Company details (edit freely). */
  company: {
    supportEmail: "support@metasync-ai.com",
    salesEmail: "sales@metasync-ai.com"
  }
};

/* ---------------- Helpers ---------------- */
const $ = (s, r=document) => r.querySelector(s);
const api = (p) => (SITE_CONFIG.apiBase || "") + p;

function fmtBytes(b){
  if(!b || b<=0) return "";
  const mb = b/1048576;
  return mb>=1 ? mb.toFixed(1)+" MB" : Math.round(b/1024)+" KB";
}
function fmtDate(iso){
  if(!iso) return "";
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return isNaN(d) ? "" : d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{year:'numeric',month:'short',day:'numeric'});
}

/* ---------------- Download / release ---------------- */
async function loadRelease(){
  let rel = { ...SITE_CONFIG.fallback };
  try{
    const res = await fetch(api(SITE_CONFIG.releaseEndpoint), { headers:{ 'Accept':'application/json' } });
    if(res.ok){
      const data = await res.json();
      const r = data.release || data.data || data;
      rel = {
        version: r.version || rel.version,
        versionCode: r.versionCode || rel.versionCode,
        sizeBytes: r.sizeBytes || r.size || rel.sizeBytes,
        url: r.url || r.downloadUrl || rel.url,
        releasedAt: r.releasedAt || r.date || "",
        notes: r.notes || r.changelog || rel.notes
      };
    }
  }catch(e){ /* offline / CORS -> fallback */ }

  const size = fmtBytes(rel.sizeBytes);
  const date = fmtDate(rel.releasedAt);

  $("#verBadge").textContent = "v" + rel.version;
  $("#verMeta").textContent = [size, date ? "Released "+date : "", "Android"].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
  $("#notesBody").innerHTML = String(rel.notes).replace(/\n/g,"<br>");

  const dl = $("#dlBtn");
  dl.href = rel.url;
  dl.setAttribute("download","");

  const copy = $("#copyBtn");
  copy.onclick = (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(rel.url).then(()=>{
      copy.textContent = "Copied ✓";
      setTimeout(()=>copy.textContent="Copy link",1600);
    });
  };

  // QR points to the stable download page URL (falls back to direct url).
  const qrTarget = SITE_CONFIG.downloadPageUrl || rel.url;
  $("#qrUrl").textContent = qrTarget;
  renderQR(qrTarget);
}

function renderQR(url){
  const box = $("#qrBox");
  box.innerHTML = "";
  try{
    if(window.QRCode){
      new QRCode(box, { text:url, width:210, height:210, colorDark:"#000000", colorLight:"#ffffff", correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.H });
      return;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  // Fallback: QR image service
  const img = document.createElement("img");
  img.alt = "Download QR code";
  img.src = "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=220x220&margin=6&data=" + encodeURIComponent(url);
  box.appendChild(img);
}

/* ---------------- Client login ---------------- */
function bindLogin(){
  const form = $("#loginForm");
  const msg = $("#loginMsg");
  const btn = $("#loginBtn");

  form.addEventListener("submit", async (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = $("#email").value.trim();
    const password = $("#password").value;
    msg.className = "form-msg info";
    msg.textContent = "Connecting…";
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Logging in…";

    try{
      const res = await fetch(api("/api/auth/login"), {
        method:"POST",
        headers:{ "Content-Type":"application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
      });
      let data = {};
      try{ data = await res.json(); }catch(_){}

      if(res.ok && (data.success !== false)){
        msg.className = "form-msg ok";
        msg.textContent = "Login successful — opening your dashboard…";
        try{ if(data.token) localStorage.setItem("metasync_token", data.token); }catch(_){}
        setTimeout(()=>{ window.location.href = SITE_CONFIG.portalUrl; }, 700);
      }else{
        msg.className = "form-msg err";
        msg.textContent = data.message || "Login failed. Please check your details.";
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Log in";
      }
    }catch(err){
      msg.className = "form-msg err";
      msg.textContent = "Network error. Please try again.";
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Log in";
    }
  });

  $("#registerLink").href = SITE_CONFIG.registerUrl;
  $("#forgotLink").href = SITE_CONFIG.forgotUrl;
}

/* ---------------- Misc ---------------- */
function init(){
  $("#year").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  $("#supportEmail").textContent = SITE_CONFIG.company.supportEmail;
  $("#supportEmail").href = "mailto:" + SITE_CONFIG.company.supportEmail;
  $("#salesEmail").textContent = SITE_CONFIG.company.salesEmail;
  $("#salesEmail").href = "mailto:" + SITE_CONFIG.company.salesEmail;
  $("#adminLink").href = SITE_CONFIG.adminUrl;

  // Mobile nav
  const burger = $("#burger"), links = $("#navLinks");
  burger.addEventListener("click", ()=> links.classList.toggle("open"));
  links.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{ if(e.target.tagName==="A") links.classList.remove("open"); });

  // Reveal on scroll
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(en=>{ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
  }, { threshold:.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(el=> io.observe(el));

  bindLogin();
  loadRelease();
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
</script>

<!-- ============================================================
     Content protection — disable right-click + common shortcuts
     (Forms, links and scrolling keep working normally.)
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
(function(){
  // 1) Disable the right-click / context menu (desktop + mobile long-press)
  document.addEventListener("contextmenu", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); return false; }, false);

  // 2) Block common "view source" / devtools keyboard shortcuts
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    var k = (e.key || "").toLowerCase();
    if (e.key === "F12") { e.preventDefault(); return false; }                                   // DevTools
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && (k === "i" || k === "j" || k === "c")) {       // Inspect/Console
      e.preventDefault(); return false;
    }
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (k === "u" || k === "s")) {                                  // View-source / Save
      e.preventDefault(); return false;
    }
  }, false);

  // 3) Stop images from being dragged off the page
  document.addEventListener("dragstart", function(e){
    if (e.target && e.target.tagName === "IMG") e.preventDefault();
  }, false);

  // 4) Discourage casual copying of text (inputs / textareas stay fully usable)
  document.addEventListener("copy", function(e){
    var t = e.target;
    if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || t.isContentEditable)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
  }, false);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
